subject: Proposed Rent Stabilization Home Rule Petition
overview: The committee deliberated on a proposed home rule petition for rent stabilization and just-cause eviction protections to address housing displacement. Members voted to split the proposal into a new legislative item and seek formal feedback from city staff and councilors.

items.title: Paper 22-310: Housing Home Rule Petitions
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to assign a new legislative paper number to a proposed rent stabilization draft and recirculate it for staff feedback after debating the merits of home rule protections for tenants. Vice President Kit Collins and President Zac Bears argued that the petition is necessary to address corporate-led displacement while providing exemptions for small owner-occupied properties. Councilor George Scarpelli and property owners raised concerns about potential building deterioration and the impact on landlord rights, while tenant advocates from City Life/Vida Urbana spoke in favor of the stability measures. The item remains in committee to allow for a formal review by the city's housing planner and the submission of councilor comments by February 28.
